info.title: devctl reservation and Kubernetes gateway API
info.description: Whole-cluster exclusive bookings by default, holder-approved sharing, and an authenticated Kubernetes API gateway. Original static kubeconfigs stay encrypted on the server. Developer configs contain public gateway metadata and a devctl exec credential command. Reservation endpoints do not automatically provision or clean Kubernetes resources.

get.summary: Forward an authenticated Kubernetes API request for an owned active session
get.description: This is a catch-all Kubernetes API proxy, not a remote shell endpoint. The gateway validates signature, issuer, API audience, expiry, access-token marker, group membership, session ownership, ACTIVE state and lease. The registry supplies the destination and server-held credentials; client identity/impersonation credentials are not forwarded as Kubernetes identity. Query strings, HTTP response streaming and bidirectional upgrades are supported. Long requests are rechecked at DEVCTL_GATEWAY_RECHECK_INTERVAL (default 1s); stalled rechecks fail closed within their 5s check timeout. Upstream permissions and workload effects are unchanged. The precise Kubernetes resource schema depends on the target API. The upstream connection intentionally uses HTTP/1.1 for SPDY/WebSocket upgrade compatibility; HTTPS verification remains enabled.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Owned session ID.

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: Catch-all Kubernetes API suffix, including slashes, for example api/v1/namespaces/default/pods. This server route preserves the suffix and query string.

200.description: Upstream Kubernetes response; content type and status are preserved. Watch/log responses may stream.

101.description: Bidirectional upgraded Kubernetes stream (for example WebSocket/SPDY), passed through by the gateway.

401.description: Invalid access token or unapproved user

502.description: Registered upstream is unavailable or its TLS/transport fails; upstream secrets are not included in the diagnostic.

default.description: Other upstream Kubernetes statuses and response content are passed through, including resource-specific errors. Do not assume all upstream responses are JSON.

post.summary: Renew authorization for an active automatic binding
post.description: Require a valid OIDC access token and Kubernetes activity within two minutes. Renew only this owner and exact active session. Expiry is capped by the token real expiry and booking expiry; a client cannot supply an expiry. This call does not count as activity or renew the cluster booking.

get.summary: Forward Kubernetes requests for an owned automatic binding
get.description: Resolve an existing immutable automatic binding scoped to the authenticated issuer and subject, then forward to its recorded session using the gateway transport. Every new request requires a valid backend-audience OIDC access token. Original Kubernetes credentials remain on the backend. Requests never allocate or silently select another cluster. Accepted requests and authorized open streams record activity, throttled to once per 30 seconds. Automatic streams recheck the exact reservation and the server authorization lease; a fresh authenticated heartbeat may renew the lease beyond the original stream token expiry, bounded by the new verified token and booking expiry. Ended bookings, expired authorization and database failures close streams. TLS, header filtering, traversal rejection and bidirectional upgrade handling match the session-ID gateway.

bearerAuth.description: Trusted issuer, API audience, valid signature and expiry, explicit access-token marker and approved group required. ID tokens rejected.

last_activity_at.description: Last accepted Kubernetes API request or authorized open stream observation; control-plane heartbeat calls do not count as activity.

ttl.description: Optional Go duration, 1m through 168h; omitted means no expiry

kubeconfig.description: Administrator-only import of one portable context with static embedded token or certificate/key and verified HTTPS. Encrypted immediately, used only by the backend transport, and never returned to developers.

server.description: Configured developer-facing HTTPS gateway URL, suffixed with /k8s/sessions/{id}. HTTP gateway configs are rejected even on loopback because client-go skips exec authentication over HTTP.

certificate_authority_data.description: Optional base64-encoded public PEM CA data for gateway TLS, never upstream client credentials.

authorization_expires_at.description: Server-recorded authorization lease capped by verified access-token and booking expiry.

server.description: Stable configured HTTPS gateway URL for this automatic binding, returned by ensure.

certificate_authority_data.description: Optional base64 public PEM gateway CA; never upstream credentials.
